title: Predicting Privacy Leakage from Weight Spectral Density
abstract: arXiv:2609.11780v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are widely used to audit the privacy disclosure risk of machine learning models, however current state-of-the-art attacks require training computationally expensive shadow models, making large-scale privacy evaluation impractical. In this work, we investigate whether inexpensive spectral metrics derived from the heavy-tailed self-regularisation framework can serve as proxies for MIA vulnerability. We evaluate several WeightWatcher spectral metrics on image and tabular classification tasks and compare their relationship with MIA privacy leakage against conventional measures of generalisation. Across datasets, stable rank exhibits a strong positive correlation with overall MIA success, while Log alpha-Norm shows a consistent negative correlation with MIA vulnerability at the low false-positive regime. translated_title: 基于权重谱密度的隐私泄露预测
translated_abstract: 成员推断攻击（MIA）被广泛用于审计机器学习模型的隐私泄露风险，然而目前最先进的攻击方法需要训练计算成本高昂的影子模型，使得大规模隐私评估变得不切实际。在本工作中，我们研究了从重尾自正则化框架中推导出的低成本谱度量是否可以作为MIA脆弱性的替代指标。我们在图像和表格分类任务上评估了多种WeightWatcher谱度量，并将它们与MIA隐私泄露的关系同传统的泛化度量进行比较。在各个数据集上，稳定秩（stable rank）与整体MIA成功率表现出强正相关，而Log alpha-范数在低假阳性区间与MIA脆弱性表现出一致的负相关。观察到这些关联比使用泛化差距所获得的关联更强。
tldr: 该论文提出利用从重尾自正则化框架推导的低成本权重谱度量（如稳定秩和Log alpha-范数）来替代计算昂贵的影子模型，有效预测机器学习模型的成员推断攻击隐私泄露风险。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that inexpensive weight spectral metrics from the heavy-tailed self-regularisation framework (such as stable rank and Log alpha-Norm) can serve as effective proxies for computationally expensive shadow models in predicting membership inference attack privacy leakage.
